text:
Anna M.: Ok team — planning a small LinkedIn + X thread to promote the 'Latency vs Cost' mini-case from the webinar next Wed. Need: post copy, hero image, 1-min clip, and SDR seed routing. Who's on this?
Liam G.: I can own scheduling + SDR seed routing. Prefer we do 2 posts on X (AM + PM) and 1 LinkedIn thread. Also up for an A/B headline test. :chart_with_upwards_trend:
Sophia C.: I'll produce copy variants. Quick Q: tone = product-led technical (call out metrics) or customer-story-first?
Anna M.: product-led with a short customer stat in the opener. Keep CTAs: webinar replay + signup.
Sophia C.: Dropping 3 quick variants here: 
```
Variant A (technical): "How we cut per-token cost 42% while holding latency < 150ms — behind-the-scenes from our webinar. Replay + config details. [link] #inference #mlops"
Variant B (benefit-led): "Same quality, far lower cost. See how one team reduced inference spend and sped up responses — replay inside. [link]"
Variant C (customer quote): \"Cut our inference bill in half and shipped faster\" — how they did it. Watch the 10-min recap + assets. [link]"
```
Liam G.: nice. I'll run B and C as the A/B on X. LinkedIn will use B then thread out the technical details in followups.
Elena D.: For assets I need: hero 1200x628 PNG, 1:1 thumbnail for carousel, and a 1-min clip mp4 (16:9). Also please send raw demo screenshots (high-res).
Ravi P.: I can edit the 1-min clip. Can someone add timestamps of the demo sections I should cut?
Sophia C.: Timestamps: 00:10 product intro, 00:28 batching/cache callout, 00:45 benchmark graphs, 00:55 customer quote.
Anna M.: @Liam can you confirm seedlist for SDRs? We want the demo attendees + warm webinar registrants + top-100 trial accounts. Also route hot leads to the enterprise SDR queue.
Liam G.: Confirmed. Seedlist = attendees (auto), warm regs (manual filter), top-100 trials (from Growth sheet). Routing: enterprise SDR queue if company size > 200 or spends > $5k. I'll push rules to the CRM today.
Liam G.: Also adding UTMs: `utm_source=social&utm_medium=x_linkedIn&utm_campaign=needlecast_launch` — use those exact params so analytics lines up.
microscheduler-bot: Posts queued: X variant B 2026-04-01T09:00Z, X variant C 2026-04-01T17:00Z, LinkedIn thread 2026-04-01T10:30Z. Errors: none.
Elena D.: Uploaded hero mock v1 to the design folder -> https://drive.example/needlecast/hero_v1.png. Feedback: can we make the cost delta bar bolder and add our logo safe zone?
Anna M.: Good call. @Elena please push v2 by EOD. @Sophia once final copy approved, lock the LinkedIn thread order: opener (B), followup 1 = benchmark graph, followup 2 = short clip, followup 3 = CTA + webinar replay.
Sophia C.: Will do. Draft thread (for review): 
"How we cut streaming inference costs without sacrificing latency. TL;DR: batching + KV cache + tuned kernels. Replay + configs: [link]"
Liam G.: Approve to schedule once Elena v2 is uploaded. I'll also set an internal reminder to monitor the first 60 mins of engagement and hand off leads to SDRs.
Ravi P.: I got the clip notes. Will deliver edited mp4 by tomorrow 11:00 PT.
Anna M.: Nice. Can one of you add a short pinned comment on X: "Want the config + test scripts? DM us or sign up for the replay." That helps capture sysadmin leads.
Liam G.: I'll add the pinned comment and brief the SDRs to watch for DMs.
Anna M.: Final: owner list -> Sophia (copy), Elena (design), Ravi (video), Liam (schedule + SDR routing), Anna (launch lead). Thanks all — check back here when assets are uploaded. :rocket:
